_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ticket e6abe049 / req dbb19e9a — the GUARD half (packages/cli/src/commands/bodyFrontmatterGuard.ts). Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). The production diff has THREE files and the driver mutates ONE subject, so it is split into three specs (integration-test-revert-verify §A117): this one owns the predicate, the two *-wiring.spec.json own each call site. Expectations were written BEFORE the run (§A44). ⛤ The axes Q1/Q1b/Q2 drive the VERBATIM pre-fix hub text recovered from exoas-exodev@169e6846 — so a mutant that widens or narrows the predicate is judged against the real incident, not a synthetic approximation.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/commands/bodyFrontmatterGuard.ts

M3_guard_never_detects._note: Type-preserving: the predicate still exists and compiles, the refusal never fires. Reddens every refusal axis of BOTH commands — that is the honest prediction, since both call the same helper. The acceptance axes (Q3/Q3b/Q4/Q5/Q7) stay green: they never depended on a refusal. ⛤ The dry-run axes (Q9/Q10) joined this set when they were added: removing the wiring or emptying the predicate kills the refusal on EVERY path, dry-run included — which is why M8 is still needed to separate 'not wired at all' from 'wired, but skipped under --dry-run'.

M4_discriminator_widened_to_any_leading_._note: Drops the real-uid / real-ISO discriminator, i.e. refuses ANY body that leads with a frontmatter-like block — the naive predicate the corpus measurement rejected (31 live exo__Template assets). Q1/Q1b/Q2/Q6 stay GREEN under it, which is exactly why Q3/Q3b exist: without them the narrow predicate is unlocked and a later reader could 'simplify' it into breaking the template layer.

M5_leading_block_not_cut_at_its_own_fenc._note: The leading block then runs to the end of the body, so a real ISO timestamp QUOTED in prose below the block is read as part of it. Reddens only Q3b — the axis whose whole point is that a retro note about this very incident stays writable. Q3 (same template without the quote) stays green, which proves the two are not duplicates.

M6_dash_line_treated_as_a_fence_without_._note: A `---` thematic break then opens a block, so prose quoting a real uid between two breaks is refused. Reddens only Q5. This is the mutant that makes Q5 non-decorative: every other axis either has no leading `---` or carries a YAML key right after it.

M7_yaml_key_pattern_reverted_to_the_expo._note: Restores the pre-fix pattern CodeQL flagged (js/redos #318). Reddens ONLY Q8 — and that is STRUCTURAL, not an accident of the fixture: the two forms accept EXACTLY the same set of strings (the character class already covers `__`; verified over 12 live and edge shapes, 0 divergences), so ANY behavioural axis is blind to the difference BY CONSTRUCTION. Time is the only observable that separates them, which is why Q8 is a time-bound rather than an assertion about the verdict. Measured: 1799 ms against 0 ms on `"A" + "__0".repeat(26) + "!"`. ⛔ The same class was checked on the file's other three patterns (REAL_UID_RE, REAL_CREATED_AT_RE, ASSET_HEAD_RE) by execution, not by reading: worst case 0.46 ms on adversarial inputs up to 60k chars — none carries a nested quantifier over overlapping classes.
